def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(R) if any(g[i][j]==2 for j in range(C))]
    cols=[j for j in range(C) if any(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(R))]
    if not rows or not cols: return g
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    border=set()
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        border.add((r0,j)); border.add((r1,j))
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        border.add((i,c0)); border.add((i,c1))
    for (i,j) in border:
        if g[i][j]==2: continue
        nb=False
        for di in (-1,0,1):
            for dj in (-1,0,1):
                if di==0 and dj==0: continue
                a,b=i+di,j+dj
                if 0<=a<R and 0<=b<C and g[a][b]==2: nb=True
        if nb: g[i][j]=2
    return g
